claims.statement: Tom Allen was arrested at 2 o'clock on the morning of 1897-04-27 for shooting off a revolver in front of his saloon at Seventh and Market streets (printed as 'in f loon').
claims.excerpt: Pd at 2 o'cloc yesterday n shooting off a revolver in f loon, at Seventh and Market

claims.statement: Tom Allen was to appear before Judge Peabody on charges of disturbing the peace and a firearms offence; the charge is partly unreadable.
claims.excerpt: to appear in Judge Peabody’s jay morning on charges of dis’ ace and Sabai a! LAL firearms

claims.statement: Tom Allen's case before Judge Peabody was continued until April 30.
claims.excerpt: remained in the holdover all rhen his case was called, had until April 30

claims.statement: Tom Allen was described as an ex-champion pugilist.

notes: Text is badly garbled, so the charge and some arrest words are unreadable. Arrest date is 'yesterday' from the paper's date 1897-04-28. The continuance date assumes the case was called on the paper's date.
